newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Pakistan 146 for eight v Australia.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Pakistan 146 for eight v Australia.

text.p: Pakistan lost another wicket to be 146 for eight after 40 overs in their World Series limited overs match against Australia at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Thursday.
Aggressive middle-order batsman Shahid Afridi was caught by Anthony Stuart from the bowling of Michael Bevan for 29.
Stuart earlier routed the Pakistan top-order, taking a hat-trick to finish with the figuures of five for 26 from 10 overs. He also caught opener Inzamam-ul-Haq, also from Bevan's bowling, for 64.
Saqlain Mushtaq and Mushtaq Ahmed were the not out batsmen.
